title: Machine Learning in the AI Landscape
overview: See how learning from data fits within AI and how supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning differ.
objectives: Relate AI, machine learning, and deep learning
Match learning paradigms to problem types

method.title: Learning agents
method.body: A learning agent improves its performance element using feedback from a critic, rather than relying only on hand-coded rules.

method.title: Paradigms
method.body: Supervised learning uses labeled examples, unsupervised learning finds structure, and reinforcement learning uses rewards.

method.title: Generalization
method.body: Models should be judged on unseen data; very flexible models can overfit the training set.

method.title: Deep learning
method.body: Neural networks with many layers learn feature hierarchies and power much of modern vision and language AI.

pseudocode:
split data into train and test
model = fit(train)
train_err = error(model, train)
test_err = error(model, test)
if test_err >> train_err: regularize_or_get_more_data()
